title: endpoints.toml
description: The addresses and paths infra provides to the active platform, /etc/pinka/platform/endpoints.toml (contract v2), with the effective ports. Written by infra at every deployment, 0644 root; the schema describes the parsed TOML document. A facility's table is present only when the manifest's `requires` names it; the platform reads names and addresses from here instead of hard-coding them.

socket_dir.description: Socket directory of the service roles (group `<platform>-db`).

reader_socket_dir.description: Socket directory of the researchers' reader role and Grafana (group `pinka`).

database.description: The platform's database, named after the platform.

migrator_role.description: Owner of the schemas, used only by the `migrate` hook (`<platform>_migrator`).

roles.description: The login role of every service except `untrusted-agent`, by service name (`<platform>_<service>`); its password file is `/etc/pinka/secrets/postgres/<role>`.

otlp_grpc.description: OTLP gRPC for services, on loopback.

otlp_http.description: OTLP HTTP for services, on loopback.

vm_collector_grpc.description: OTLP gRPC for VM targets, on `vm_collector_address`.

vm_collector_http.description: OTLP HTTP for VM targets, on `vm_collector_address`.

agent_otlp_socket.description: The agent's OTLP socket; everything received there is stamped `pinka.trust=untrusted`.

query_socket.description: The read-only query proxy for Prometheus, Loki and Tempo.

mode.description: `local` (vLLM on this node), `remote` (the inference forwarder to a paired inference node) or `scripted` (only with `lab_mode = "staging"`; never official).

researcher_endpoint.description: The inference broker's researcher endpoint, the only TCP port a platform may listen on.

api_url.description: The OpenAI-compatible inference API: vLLM, the forwarder's loopback port, or the configured scripted endpoint.

control_url.description: With `remote`: the forwarder's control API on loopback.

url.description: The OPA decision API on loopback.

decision_path.description: The decision path of the manifest's `policy`, below `/v1/data/`, when the manifest has one.

url.description: The Incus HTTPS API on loopback.

projects.description: The Incus projects of the platform (`bench`, `build`).

run_network_socket.description: The run-network helper, for the controller only.

cpuset_targets.description: The CPUs of the target instances (a Linux cpuset list), when `cpuset_targets` is set; every target's `limits.cpu` is a range inside it.

arbiter_socket.description: The GPU arbiter's socket, for the controller only.

key_file.description: The platform's ed25519 signing key (PEM PKCS#8), 0400 for its controller.

published_keys_dir.description: Where the public keys are published as `<platform>-<machine>-<YYYYMMDD>.pub` and kept forever.

trusted_keys_dir.description: Trusted public keys of external verification (PEM).

attestations.description: The attestation directories; the format and the official check are the platform's.

records_dir.description: The session records, one `<boot_id>.json` per boot.

fingerprint_command.description: The command that prints the fingerprint document.

ports.description: The effective listener ports, by the names of the port table: the defaults with the machine's `ports:` overrides.
